notes.title: Winter Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings epic fans! Welcome to our first event. The team has been busy working on a number of big updates. First is our new battle map called "SnowForts". This map moves the snails to the ground popping in and out of trenches for the best shot. Second is our "Snowblaster Kit DLC". Ever since 1999 I had wanted to create a multiplayer snowball wargame. Finally 18 years later the Snowblaster has arrived. Epic Snails will remain FREE, our goal is to sell optional kits to pay the team. Thanks for helping us create our little game.


[b]New:[/b]
[list][*]New map Snowfort![/*][*]Snowblaster DLC Kit [/*][list][*]Snow Skin[/*][*]Snowblaster Cannon Skin[/*][*]Snow Helmet[/*][*]Square Headphones[/*][*]Ski Mask[/*][/list][*]Santa Hat[/*][*]Reindeer Antlers[/*][*]Round Headphones[/*][*]Post match screen will now display which players have left the match[/*][*]Added new cosmetic options for face, ear, and shell skin[/*][*]Added Face, Ears, and Skin filter options in inventory screen[/*][*]New shop UI featuring more buying options[/*][*]Added some social media buttons to the settings screen[/*][*]Each team will now have a match MVP that will get an extra match end reward[/*][*]Added feedback when the game loses connection to the servers (i.e. snails disappearing)[/*][/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list][*]The lobby has been decorated for the holidays[/*][*]Updated SFX for the assault cannon[/*][*]Assault Cannon and Missile Launcher will now properly respect accuracy damage effects[/*][list][*]Rebalanced these weapons to account for this change[/*][/list][*]Graphical fixes in Backyard[/*][*]Increased the chat scroll sensitivity[/*][*]All health pickups can now only be picked up if you are hurt[/*][*]Improved score syncing between players. Especially for players that join a match late[/*][*]Balaclava is now considered a Face item and can be worn with Helmet items[/*][/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the reload spamming glitch[/*][*]Fix for some players not being able to move when coming back to the lobby from a match[/*][*]Fix for chat getting squished while another UI is open[/*][*]Fix for super high jump glitch[/*][*]Fix for some snails floating and shaking[/*][*]Miscellaneous bug fixes[/*][/list]
